items.source: Declared queries consist of a query string and a flag whether the query is a native (SQL) one or a JPQL query. Queries can be rewritten to contain a different query string (i.e. count query derivation, sorting, projection updates) while retaining their native flag.
items.translation: 声明查询由查询字符串和一个标志组成，该标志指示查询是原生（SQL）查询还是 JPQL 查询。 查询可以被重写以包含不同的查询字符串（例如计数查询推导、排序、投影更新），同时保留其 native 标志。
重写的DeclaredQuery。
